title: Side by side: ticket, ownership, liquidity, cost, tax, selling
objectives: Compare MF, PMS and AIF on all eight side-by-side rows.
Say which certification each product's distributor needs.
body_md:
Minimum: a few hundred rupees (SIP) for MF; ₹50 lakh for PMS; ₹1 crore for AIF (₹25 lakh for manager's employees). Structure: MF pooled, investor holds units; PMS individual portfolio in client's demat; AIF pooled, investor holds units. What it can hold: MF listed equity, debt, gold within SEBI category rules; PMS mainly listed securities; AIF unlisted equity, private credit, real estate, complex strategies. Liquidity: MF usually redeem any business day; PMS exit anytime, exit loads possible in first 3 years; Cat I & II locked for the fund's life (3+ years); Cat III varies. Costs: MF expense ratio capped by SEBI; PMS fixed and/or profit-share fees by agreement; AIF management fee plus carry / performance fee. Tax: MF at redemption, in investor's hands; PMS every trade taxed in client's hands; Cat I & II pass-through for most income; Cat III generally taxed at fund level. How it's sold: MF openly with advertising; PMS through APMI-registered distributors; AIF private placement only, no public advertising. Distributor certification: MF NISM V-A; PMS NISM XXI-A; AIF NISM XIX-A (Cat I & II), XIX-B (Cat III). Tax rules change with Budgets; always confirm current treatment with a CA.

|  | Mutual fund | PMS | AIF |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Minimum | A few hundred rupees (SIP) | ₹50 lakh | ₹1 crore (₹25 lakh for manager's employees) |
| Structure | Pooled; investor holds units | Individual portfolio in client's demat | Pooled; investor holds units |
| What it can hold | Listed equity, debt, gold, etc. within SEBI category rules | Mainly listed securities | Unlisted equity, private credit, real estate, complex strategies |
| Liquidity | Usually redeem any business day | Exit anytime; exit loads possible in first 3 years | Cat I & II locked for the fund's life (3+ years); Cat III varies |
| Costs | Expense ratio capped by SEBI | Fixed and/or profit-share fees, set by agreement | Management fee plus carry / performance fee |
| Tax | At redemption, in investor's hands | Every trade taxed in client's hands | Cat I & II: pass-through for most income; Cat III: generally taxed at fund level |
| How it's sold | Openly, with advertising | Through APMI-registered distributors | Private placement only; no public advertising |
| Distributor certification | NISM V-A | NISM XXI-A | NISM XIX-A (Cat I & II), XIX-B (Cat III) |
example: A client comparing costs: MF one capped expense ratio in the NAV; PMS fixed/profit-share plus brokerage, custody, GST; AIF management fee plus carry — always show costs in rupees, side by side.
say: Show costs, lock-in and tax side by side before choosing.
Tax rules change with Budgets; confirm with a CA.
never: PMS trades are taxed only at exit.

check.q: Where are the securities held in a PMS?
o: In the client's own demat account
check.why: In the client's own demat account. This is why every trade is taxed in the client's hands.

check.q: How can an AIF be marketed?
check.why: Private placement only. Public invitation and mass marketing are not allowed.

check.q: Which NISM certification is needed to distribute Category III AIFs?
check.why: XIX-B. XIX-A is for Category I & II.
